Anchor.description:
Tags what a note or comment is attached to; exactly the field for `kind` is set.

Attributes:
    kind: What the anchor points at.
    set_id: Set, for kind `set`.
    tid: Transition, for kind `transition`.
    point: Sheet point, for kind `point`.
    area: Sheet area, for kind `area`.
    spots: Spot IDs, for kind `spots`.
Anchor.title: Anchor

ApprovalState.description: Names the collaboration states of a set.
ApprovalState.title: ApprovalState

ArcCurve.description:
Draws a circular arc.

Attributes:
    center: Circle center.
    radius: Radius in meters, above 0.
    start_deg: Start angle, counter-clockwise from +x.
    sweep_deg: Signed sweep; positive turns counter-clockwise.
ArcCurve.title: ArcCurve

AudioTrack.description:
Describes music or sound that plays alongside the show.

Attributes:
    file: Path or URI of the audio asset.
    label: Unique name of the track.
    sync_offset_s: Audio time that plays at count 0.
    gain: Linear playback gain.
    section: (start, end) counts the track covers, or None for the whole show.
AudioTrack.title: AudioTrack

BezierCurve.description:
Draws a Bézier curve of degree len(control) - 1.

Attributes:
    control: Control points; the curve starts at the first and ends at the last.
BezierCurve.title: BezierCurve

Cast.description:
Holds every group and spot in the show.

Attributes:
    groups: Group key to group; each key equals its group's `key`.
    spots: Every spot, in creation order.
    selections: Named selections of spot IDs of this cast, deduplicated in first-seen order.
    label_scheme: Labeling rules; its prefixes name groups of this cast.
Cast.title: Cast

CircleCurve.description:
Draws a full circle, counter-clockwise unless `ccw` is False.

Attributes:
    center: Circle center.
    radius: Radius in meters, above 0.
    start_deg: Angle of the start point, counter-clockwise from +x.
    ccw: Travel direction; mirroring a circle flips it.
CircleCurve.title: CircleCurve

CompositeCurve.description:
Joins curves end to end into one curve.

Attributes:
    parts: Curves in travel order.
    closed: Whether the last part ends on the first part's start.
CompositeCurve.title: CompositeCurve

CoordinateSystem.description:
Describes how positions are labeled and worded; it never moves stored positions.

Attributes:
    kind: Wording family.
    origin: Point or landmark ID that reads as zero.
    audience_side: Edge of the sheet where the audience sits, as drawn.
    units: Unit positions are written in.
    precision: Rounding step in `units`.
    labels: Words used for directions, e.g. {"left": "stage right"}.
CoordinateSystem.title: CoordinateSystem

Cue.description:
Describes one moment in cue mode.

Attributes:
    label: Unique name of the cue.
    order: Position in the running order.
    estimated_seconds: Estimated duration, so previews can play.
Cue.title: Cue

Easing.description:
Maps progress through a move (time share) to progress along it (distance share).

Attributes:
    kind: Easing family; `custom` uses `points`.
    strength: Exponent or step count, depending on the kind.
    points: Custom curve as (time share, distance share) pairs from (0, 0) to (1, 1).
Easing.title: Easing

EllipseCurve.description:
Draws a counter-clockwise oval.

Attributes:
    center: Ellipse center.
    rx: Semi-axis along the rotated x direction.
    ry: Semi-axis along the rotated y direction.
    rotation_deg: Counter-clockwise rotation of the axes.
EllipseCurve.title: EllipseCurve

EntityFacing.description:
Holds the spot a `toward_entity` facing mode looks at.

>>> EntityFacing(entity="T2").entity
'T2'

Attributes:
    kind: Tag that tells the facing values apart in stored documents.
    entity: Spot ID.
EntityFacing.title: EntityFacing

FacingMode.description: Names how a spot faces while it moves.
FacingMode.title: FacingMode

FacingOverride.description:
Forces a facing on spots over a global count range, regardless of paths.

Attributes:
    entities: Spots affected.
    mode: Facing mode during the range.
    value: Typed value the mode reads; None for modes that read none.
    start: Global count where the override starts.
    end: Global count where it ends.
    turn_counts: Counts spent turning into and out of the override.
FacingOverride.title: FacingOverride

FacingSpec.description:
Describes how form members face.

Attributes:
    mode: `fixed`, `audience`, `toward_point`, `along`, `normal` or `outward`.
    value: Degrees for fixed, a point for toward_point; for along, normal and outward an
        optional offset in degrees added to the computed facing.
FacingSpec.title: FacingSpec

FigureEightParams.description:
Holds the parameters of the built-in figure_eight motion.

>>> FigureEightParams().amplitude
1.0

Attributes:
    amplitude: Side offset in meters; negative mirrors the loops.
FigureEightParams.title: FigureEightParams

FixedFacing.description:
Holds the heading a `fixed` facing mode holds.

>>> FixedFacing(degrees=450.0).degrees
90.0

Attributes:
    kind: Tag that tells the facing values apart in stored documents.
    degrees: Heading wrapped to [0, 360); 0 faces the audience, counter-clockwise positive.
FixedFacing.title: FixedFacing

Form.description:
Holds a stored shape construction plus its ordered members.

Attributes:
    id: Form ID, unique across the show.
    set: Set the form belongs to.
    kind: Shape family.
    geometry: JSON construction recipe the slots are generated from.
    members: Spots in slot order.
    spacing: How members are spaced on the shape.
    facing: How members face.
    locked: Designer lock; edits need force=True.
    meta: Free designer metadata.
Form.title: Form

Grid.description:
Describes the background grid.

Attributes:
    origin: A grid intersection.
    spacing: Cell size along x and y.
    major_every: Every n-th line is drawn heavier.
    rotation_deg: Counter-clockwise grid rotation.
    unit_name: Unit the grid is labeled in.
Grid.title: Grid

Group.description:
Holds a designer-made set of spots with shared defaults.

Attributes:
    key: Stable group key, e.g. `trumpets`.
    name: Display name; defaults to the key in title case.
    label_prefix: Prefix for spot labels, e.g. `T` gives T1, T2.
    symbol: Sheet glyph.
    color: Hex color, `#rrggbb`.
    default_radius: Footprint radius for new spots, above 0.
    limits: Per-group limit overrides read by a consumer checker.
    moves: False for stationary groups such as a pit.
Group.title: Group

GuideLine.description:
Holds one line drawn on the sheet.

Attributes:
    id: Guide ID.
    kind: yard, hash, sideline, center, edge, spike or custom.
    points: Vertices of the line.
    label: Text drawn with the line.
GuideLine.title: GuideLine

Hold.description:
Pauses the counts: time reaches `at_count`, waits `seconds`, then continues.

Attributes:
    at_count: Count where the pause happens.
    seconds: Length of the pause.
    note: Designer note such as "fermata".
Hold.title: Hold

LabelScheme.description:
Holds labeling rules; a group missing from `prefixes` uses its own label_prefix.

Attributes:
    prefixes: Group key to label prefix overrides; every key names a group of the cast.
    start: First number in each group.
    pad: Zero-pad numbers to this width, 0 to `MAX_LABEL_PAD`.
LabelScheme.title: LabelScheme

Landmark.description:
Holds a named reference such as "front hash" or "center stage".

Attributes:
    id: Landmark ID.
    name: Display name.
    kind: point (1 point), line (2+ points) or area (3+ points, a ring).
    geometry: Points of the landmark.
    aliases: Other names that resolve to it.
Landmark.title: Landmark

Marker.description:
Names one moment, such as "the hit" or "letter B".

Attributes:
    label: Unique name of the moment.
    at_count: Count where it happens.
    kind: What the marker is for.
Marker.title: Marker

MeasureSetting.description:
Configures measure numbering for designers who talk in measures.

Attributes:
    counts_per_measure: Measure length from count 0; finite and above 0.
    start_measure: Number of the measure that starts at count 0.
    changes: (count, new length) pairs; each starts a new measure at its count. Counts are
        at least 0 and strictly increasing, lengths finite and above 0.
MeasureSetting.title: MeasureSetting

Note.description:
Holds one design note.

Attributes:
    id: Note ID.
    text: Note body.
    kind: goal, idea, todo or warning.
    anchor: What the note is attached to.
    author: User name, or "agent".
    created_at: When the note was written; passed in, never read from the clock.
    visible: Whether the canvas shows it.
Note.title: Note

PathRow.description:
Holds one spot's instructions for one transition; times are local counts.

Attributes:
    entity: Spot ID.
    style: Path style.
    start: Local count the move starts.
    end: Local count the move ends; None means the end of the transition.
    waypoints: Points passed on the way, for CURVE and POLYLINE.
    route: Route followed, for FOLLOW.
    pivot: Rotation center, for ROTATE.
    sweep_deg: Signed rotation, for ROTATE; positive is counter-clockwise.
    facing_mode: How the spot faces during the move.
    facing_value: Typed value the facing mode reads; None for modes that read none.
    turn_counts: Counts spent turning into and out of the move's facing.
    turn_direction: Which way turns go.
    pace: Step pace multiplier for step-size reporting; positions ignore it.
    locked: Designer lock.
    note: Free text.
    motion_fn: Registered motion function, for CUSTOM.
    motion_params: The built-in motion's typed parameters, or a read-only JSON object for a
        registered custom motion.
    easing: How progress maps to time across the window.
PathRow.title: PathRow

Pin.description:
Records one designer lock; the flags it sets live on placements, forms and path rows.

Attributes:
    target: What is locked.
    id: Spot, form or set ID, or a transition written as `a→b`.
    by: Who pinned it.
    reason: Why, shown to the agent when an edit is refused.
Pin.title: Pin

Placement.description:
Holds one spot's state at one set.

Attributes:
    entity: Spot ID.
    x: Meters from the center line, audience-left negative.
    y: Meters upstage from the front edge.
    facing: Degrees, 0 toward the audience, counter-clockwise positive.
    form: Form the spot belongs to in this set.
    order: Index along that form.
    pinned: Designer lock; edits need force=True.
    note: Text printed on sheets.
    on_field: False before an entrance or after an exit; not drawn or collision-checked.
Placement.title: Placement

PointFacing.description:
Holds the point a `toward_point` facing mode looks at.

>>> PointFacing(point=(1.0, 2.0)).point
(1.0, 2.0)

Attributes:
    kind: Tag that tells the facing values apart in stored documents.
    point: Meters on the sheet.
PointFacing.title: PointFacing

Polyline.description:
Connects points with straight pieces.

Attributes:
    points: Vertices in order; a closed polyline does not repeat the first one.
    closed: Whether a final piece returns to the first vertex.
Polyline.title: Polyline

Region.description:
Stores an area on the stage plane as rings, so it survives JSON round-trips.

Attributes:
    exterior: Outer ring, not repeating the first point.
    holes: Inner rings cut out of the area.
Region.title: Region

Route.description:
Holds a shared path for follow-the-leader.

Members start on the route at arc lengths `offsets` and all advance `travel` meters.

Attributes:
    id: Route ID.
    curve: Path the route follows, any curve kind.
    members: Spots on the route, leader first.
    offsets: Each member's starting arc length on the route.
    travel: Meters every member advances.
    start: Local count the move starts.
    end: Local count the move ends; None means the end of the transition.
Route.title: Route

Segment.description:
Draws a straight line from `a` to `b`.

Attributes:
    a: Start point.
    b: End point.
Segment.title: Segment

Selection.description:
Holds an ordered, duplicate-free set of spot IDs.

Attributes:
    ids: Spot IDs in selection order.
    description: How the selection was made, for display.
Selection.title: Selection

Set.description:
Holds a snapshot of every spot's placement at one moment.

Attributes:
    id: Set ID, e.g. `12` or `12A`.
    key: Stable storage key, fixed when the set is created; defaults to the ID.
        A key that differs from the ID must pass check_id.
    counts: Counts since the previous set; 0 for the first.
    placements: One placement per spot in the cast.
    forms: Forms present in this set.
    label: Designer label.
    cue: Rehearsal mark or cue.
    source_hash: Hash of the script that built the set.
    state: Collaboration state.
Set.title: Set

Shape.description:
Describes a spot's footprint for display and collisions.

Attributes:
    kind: `circle` or `rectangle`.
    radius_m: Circle radius.
    width_m: Rectangle size across the facing direction.
    depth_m: Rectangle size along the facing direction.
    rotation_deg: Extra rotation added to the spot's facing for rectangles.
Shape.title: Shape

Sheet.description:
Holds the 2D design surface; (0, 0) is the front-center of the sheet.

Attributes:
    ref: Sheet reference, `sheet:<id>@<version>`.
    name: Display name.
    surface_type: Surface family.
    size_m: Width and depth in meters.
    outline: Sheet edge ring.
    walkable: Area performers may use.
    guides: Lines drawn on the sheet.
    landmarks: Named references.
    zones: Rule-bearing areas.
    grid: Background grid.
    default_coordinates: Coordinate system new shows start with.
    based_on: Template this sheet was customized from.
    owner: Who saved the sheet.
    thumbnail: Asset URI of a preview image.
Sheet.title: Sheet

SpacingSpec.description:
Describes how members are spaced on a form's shape.

Attributes:
    mode: `count` (even over the window), `interval` (fixed gap) or `proportional`.
    interval: Gap in meters for interval mode.
    start: Arc length where spacing starts.
    end: Arc length where spacing ends; None means the end of the shape.
    align: `start`, `end` or `center` for interval mode.
    gaps: Extra meters after member indexes.
SpacingSpec.title: SpacingSpec

SpiralCurve.description:
Draws an Archimedean spiral whose radius changes linearly with angle.

Attributes:
    center: Spiral center.
    r0: Start radius.
    r1: End radius.
    turns: Number of counter-clockwise turns, above 0.
    start_deg: Start angle, counter-clockwise from +x.
SpiralCurve.title: SpiralCurve

SpiralParams.description:
Holds the parameters of the built-in spiral motion: half a turn plus whole extra turns.

>>> SpiralParams(turns=2).clockwise
False

Attributes:
    turns: Extra full turns around the midpoint of the move.
    clockwise: Turns clockwise instead of counter-clockwise.
SpiralParams.title: SpiralParams

SplineCurve.description:
Passes a centripetal Catmull–Rom spline through every point.

Attributes:
    points: Points the curve passes through, in order.
    alpha: Knot exponent; 0.5 (centripetal) avoids cusps and self-loops.
    closed: Whether the spline loops back to the first point.
SplineCurve.title: SplineCurve

Spot.description:
Describes one dot that persists through the whole show.

Attributes:
    id: Label shown on the sheet, stable all show.
    group: Key of the owning group.
    symbol: Sheet glyph; None inherits the group's.
    color: Hex color, `#rrggbb`; None inherits the group's.
    tags: Free tags such as `soloist`, deduplicated in first-seen order; a set is sorted.
    active: False excludes the spot from forms and checks.
    shape: Footprint on the sheet and for collisions.
    claimable: Who may claim the spot once the show is published.
Spot.title: Spot

SurfaceType.description: Names the kinds of surface a sheet represents.
SurfaceType.title: SurfaceType

SvgCurve.description:
Evaluates one SVG subpath, mapped onto the stage plane by an affine transform.

Attributes:
    d: Path data for exactly one subpath, in absolute commands.
    transform: 3x3 affine matrix from SVG units to stage meters.
    closed: Whether the subpath ends with Z.
SvgCurve.title: SvgCurve

TempoSection.description:
Sets how fast counts go from a count onward.

Attributes:
    at_count: Count where the section starts.
    counts_per_minute: Tempo at the start of the section.
    ramp_to: Tempo reached at the end of the ramp, or None for a steady tempo.
    ramp_counts: Counts the ramp takes, changing tempo linearly in counts.
TempoSection.title: TempoSection

Timeline.description:
Holds the whole show timeline.

Construction refuses a timeline the clock could not convert: tempo sections out of order,
two at one count or a first that is not at count 0; two cues with one order; holds out of
order, two at one count or outside the show; a negative `total_counts`.

Attributes:
    mode: How the show is timed.
    tempos: Tempo sections sorted by count; the first starts at count 0.
    holds: Pauses sorted by count, at most one per count, inside the show.
    markers: Named moments sorted by count.
    measures: Measure numbering, or None when measures are off.
    cues: Cue-mode moments sorted by order.
    audio: Playback tracks.
    total_counts: Length of the show in counts, when known.
Timeline.title: Timeline

TimelineMode.description: Names how a show is timed.
TimelineMode.title: TimelineMode

TransitionSpec.description:
Holds every path instruction for one transition.

Rows are sparse: a spot without a row moves straight over the full counts.

Attributes:
    id: (from set, to set).
    counts: Length of the transition; equals the destination set's counts.
    rows: Spot ID to path row, read-only; every key equals its row's spot.
    routes: Route ID to route, read-only; every key equals its route's ID.
    notes: Free text.
    source_hash: Hash of the script that wrote the paths.
TransitionSpec.title: TransitionSpec

TrimmedCurve.description:
Views the piece of `base` between arc lengths s0 and s1, reversed when s0 > s1.

Attributes:
    base: Curve being trimmed.
    s0: Arc length on `base` where this curve starts.
    s1: Arc length on `base` where this curve ends.
TrimmedCurve.title: TrimmedCurve

TurnDirection.description: Names which way a facing turn goes.
TurnDirection.title: TurnDirection

Waypoint.description:
Holds a point a path passes through.

Attributes:
    x: Meters.
    y: Meters.
    at: Local count to pass the point; None keeps constant speed.
Waypoint.title: Waypoint

WeaveParams.description:
Holds the parameters of the built-in weave motion: a sinusoidal side-to-side offset.

>>> WeaveParams(cycles=1.5).amplitude
1.0

Attributes:
    amplitude: Side offset in meters; negative starts to the other side.
    cycles: Side-to-side cycles, a positive multiple of 0.5.
WeaveParams.title: WeaveParams

ZigzagParams.description:
Holds the parameters of the built-in zigzag motion: a triangle-wave side offset.

>>> ZigzagParams(cycles=1).cycles
1.0

Attributes:
    amplitude: Side offset in meters; negative starts to the other side.
    cycles: Side-to-side cycles, a positive multiple of 0.5.
ZigzagParams.title: ZigzagParams

Zone.description:
Holds an area with rules.

Attributes:
    id: Zone ID.
    kind: What the area is for.
    polygon: The area.
    applies_to: Spots the rules apply to.
    active: Global count windows when the zone applies; None means always.
    note: Designer note.
Zone.title: Zone

ZoneKind.description: Names the kinds of rule-bearing area.
ZoneKind.title: ZoneKind

description: A stored tree as one object mapping each show-document path to its JSON.
title: ShowPy stored show, format version 2
